reviewed_by: Codex focused review for live provider tool activity
reason: A provider chat must show which tool is running and let the operator expand each call independently, including after reload. The selected API test covers durable ledger names, statuses, and inputs. Ledger component tests cover current-action priority and independent disclosure. Mocked browser journeys cover live streaming and pending-turn UI reload; the production real-Core LAN journey covers the persisted workflow in the desktop and mobile browser matrix.
exclusions: No full suite approval was given. Native tests and unrelated provider or harness journeys are unchanged. Browser tests use a seeded pending tool ledger instead of executing an external SSH command. Mobile profiles are emulated; no physical device is available. Tool inputs remain behind explicit per-call disclosure.
